mapper.select: select FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType from FIN_CASH_INFO, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeType10}, #{feeType11}, #{feeType99}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID finprodId from FIN_CASH_INFO, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE, (SELECT YIELD,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE UNION SELECT NULL,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE)FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeFloat},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
UNION ALL select FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID finprodId from FIN_CASH_INFO, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE, (SELECT YIELD,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE UNION SELECT NULL,BASE_DATE_TYPE,CASH_ID,EFF_DATE FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE)FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and (FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2}) and FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeFloat},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

select distinct FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE feeType, MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE payFeeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE calcFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE payFeeTradeRule, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD * 100 feeRate, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.BASE_DATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstCalEndDate, MST_FEEINFO.CHARGE_TYPE chargeType from FIN_CASH_INFO, MST_FEEINFO, PTL_MANAGE_OBJ, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE, FIN_PRODUCT left join prd_layer_param on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = prd_layer_param.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{ptlId} and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} and MST_FEEINFO.FEE_TYPE in (#{feeTypeTrust}, #{feeTypeFix}, #{feeTypeSale}, #{feeTypeOthSale}, #{feeTypeThService},#{feeTypeInvest}) and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = #{branch}

SELECT ACCT_NO acctNo, CCY ccy, BUSI_ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, ACCT_NAME acctName, BANK_DEP bankDep, IN_OUT_BANK inOutBank, CORR_NO corrNo, LARGE_PAYNO largePayno, SWIFT_CODE swiftCode, BLN_AREA blnArea, IS_OVERDRAW isOverdraw, REMARK remark FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.CASH_ID, T3.BASE_TYPE basicBill, T3.BASIS, T1.COLLECT_TYPE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 INNER JOIN MST_FEEINFO T2 ON T1.FEE_ID = T2.FEE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T4.VDATE WHERE T1.CASH_TYPE_2 in ('C11','C12','C13') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T2.FEE_ID = #{feeId}
